implementation.scope: Existing exact-root call and endpoint owners prepare shared-authority storage and private payload nodes outside IPC. Pending call waiter-list construction leaves IPC too. Shared count admission still precedes payload/list allocation.
phases: Prepare captured shared-authority metadata outside IPC; no capability identity admitted yet.
Under IPC, revalidate captured namespace/retirement and reserve shared count/identity by relinking prepared authority metadata.
Leave IPC before private payload allocation and call pending waiter-list construction; revalidate again at staging/publication.
implementation.ownership: PreparingCapability retains captured identity, PreparedReservation, admitted Reservation and private payload in one inert owner within the existing exact-root parent. Ordinary unused/rejected metadata disposes post-IPC, root last; complete fallback retains all fields. Kernel roots remain immortal and synthetic fixtures use explicit namespaces.
implementation.publication: Call staging only revalidates completed metadata. Endpoint publication borrows its admitted reservation and relinks endpoint/capability nodes. Hidden delivery, loan revocation and physical cleanup proofs unchanged.

controls.existing_fixture_footprint_change: The existing unpublished call and endpoint owners now also retain their newly prepared authority/payloads: two extra staged capability pairs and one pending waiter-list allocation, with the same existing roots/record/slot charges. Other deliberately retained prefixes remain counted.
controls.injection_qualification: Explicit stage errors and existing actual shared-record factory rejection hook; not global allocator exhaustion or exhaustive concurrency.

remaining: direct/delegated grant, receiver reply and returned connection capability factories still under IPC using the same guarded adapter
commit_transfers_with_delivery still allocates its publication vector under IPC, including scalar-only calls; heap-held call control covers staging only
other vector/control/list factories, weak retention, field destructors and wider caller IRQ/guard contexts
private metadata byte/principal ceilings and allocator overhead
linear registry traversal and repeated reference/close scans; sustained pressure fairness/progress
historical mapping panic, root-close timeout and initial HTTP timeout causes
implementation.guarded_adapter_validation: Preserves the early captured IPC namespace/retirement rejection before guarded factories, then revalidates again at shared reservation. No new unlocked interval for guarded callers.
